notes: Phase 2: Fixed title width resize erratic on first click. Root cause: dragStartBoxWidth was set to null when titleBoxWidth was null (auto-fit mode), causing resize to fall back to hardcoded 400px. Fix: compute actual rendered width via computeBounds() on pointerdown. Added 2 tests (auto-fit resize from computed width, custom width resize from set width). All 31 TitleInteraction tests pass. Full suite: 1155 tests, 1 pre-existing failure in SaliencyDebugOverlayTest (unrelated). world-review completed — no critical issues found; computeBounds already defensive against edge cases (empty runs return 24px min, measureText always finite).
